proposedOverrides.name: Gunaikurnai
proposedOverrides.summary: Gunaikurnai communities connect Gippsland Country with clan relationships, stoneworking, cultural fire and living knowledge. Colonial displacement disrupted access and families; community life continues, including native title recognition in 2010.

proposedOverrides.name: Ngarrindjeri
proposedOverrides.summary: Ngarrindjeri communities connect the lower Murray, lakes, Coorong and Sea Country through fishing, kinship, law and creative practice. Feather flowers, weaving and David Unaipon's papers illuminate skill and adaptation; cultural life continues despite dispossession and environmental damage.
